column1: # Long S4D architecture ablation, 10/18. One factor at a time around the best recipe (Li-ion only, readout + R_FIRST,
#   geo_bins, wd 1e-3, constant lr 1e-4, patience 5; default arch d_model 64 / 4 layers / d_state 16 / expand 2 /
# All arms use S4_BACKEND=scan (same LTI S4D, ZOH, matches fft to 1e-4 in test_s4d; ~3-4x faster, ~half the memory), so
#   the deep / wide arms fit the time limit. S4aBase = the default arch on scan, the in-sweep reference.
# GRAD_CKPT=1 (memory only, same math) on the deep / wide arms. Batch 8 x accum 4 everywhere (effective 32).
# Depth {8, 16, 24}, d_model {32, 128}, expand {1, 4}, d_state {32, 64, 98}, dt init standard [1e-3, 1e-1].
# H_RT guesses: 30 h, 48 h for 16 / 24 layers -- check s/iter in the first log of S4aL24.
